headline: Nifty Eyes 23,200 Resistance as Coal India Production Surges and Affle Announces $420M Acquisition

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Coal India reported a 19% increase in production as mining operations recovered after the monsoon slump.
Affle 3i announced a $420 million all-cash deal to acquire Israel-based Perion Network.
Nifty reclaimed the 23,000 level in the previous session, gaining over 116 points.
Market sentiment is shifting toward a potential 'Diwali bonanza' as bulls attempt to push the index higher.
whatHappening: The Nifty 50 index is facing immediate resistance at 23,200 with bulls aiming for the 24,000 mark.
Power utilities in Southern Odisha and Andhra Pradesh are on high alert due to Cyclone 'Murasu' in the Bay of Bengal.
A new Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper Train is set to connect major economic hubs across three states.
Analysts are monitoring whether the Sensex and Nifty can extend gains during the November 2-6 trading week.
summary: The Indian market enters the first week of November with Nifty eyeing the 23,200 resistance level after reclaiming 23,000. Coal India reported strong production growth of 19%, while Affle 3i made headlines with a significant $420 million international acquisition. Investors are looking for a potential Diwali rally as the market attempts to rebound from recent lows.
